race.comment: BOHEMIAN BRAIDS (2) has been racing well of late. Finished fourth at his latest appearance over 1800m at Globe Derby Park, beaten 6 metres. No excuses from this advantageous draw. Meets a comparable field and he can take this out. ACCELERE NZ (6) made a nice return at his latest appearance a week ago, finishing 3 metres away in third over 2190m at this track. Leading hope in a similar race. SNEAKY PHILTRA (7) didn't do a bad job when fourth over 2190m here last time out. Top-three aspirations. HESASTAR (1) has drawn to advantage and should give backers a great sight.
